name: Jaipur
tagline: Grand convention resorts & cultural heritage summits
intro: High-capacity convention hotels with expansive palace lawns, world-class banqueting, and close flight connectivity from Delhi & Mumbai.
access: About five hours by road from Delhi, or a short flight.
highlights: Close enough to Delhi NCR to drive, which removes air fares from the budget entirely for a two-night programme.
Heritage venues and palace hotels give an annual dinner a sense of occasion that a city banquet hall cannot.
Strong fit for educational tours: forts, observatory and craft workshops support a real itinerary rather than sightseeing filler.
planning_note: Afternoons are punishing from April onward. Outdoor dinners and fort visits work well between November and February.
